Two running_header elements therefore appear: 'BIOLOGY' at the head (y 0.071) and 'Reprint 2026-27' at the foot (y 0.901). SCAN OFFSET: the raster is shifted left of the physical sheet. The brown corner block and the folio tab both start at x=0 with no white margin (they are cut off), while the right side leaves 71 px of white beyond the green band and 177 px beyond the text. Consistently, the footer line's centre is 791.5 px, 35 px left of the raster centre 827. All bboxes reported here are raster-relative and self-consistent; a consumer re-registering the page to its true trim should shift everything right by roughly 35-70 px. page.fill = 0.96 is DERIVED, not directly measured: body type runs from y 237 to its last baseline at y 1970 with no internal slack, and the nearest furniture below is the footer line at y 2107. Taking the frame bottom as the last plausible baseline position (~y 2050, one line clear of the footer) gives (1970-237)/(2050-237) = 0.96. The page is effectively full - it could have held about three more 39 px lines. size_pt values are DERIVED, not measured: dpi is known (200.05), so cap height in pt = cap_px/200.05*72, and size_pt = that divided by an assumed 0.70 cap-height-to-em ratio. The assumed ratio is the only guess in them; size_rel is the measured, reliable number and should be preferred. All six A2 blocks were matched to positions with confidence; no block is unmatched and no element carries a guessed n. The red 'Pollen Products' label and the 'Bee Pollen', '30 TABLETS' and 'NET WEIGHT .45 OZ.' lettering are printed artwork inside the montage, not page elements, so they are not listed separately. A diagonal 'not to be republished / (c) NCERT' watermark crosses the page from about y 700 to y 1800; it is a light grey overlay, carries no layout meaning, and was excluded from every measurement by thresholding, but it is the reason some raw row profiles show faint ink in otherwise blank bands.
